title: Alignment, before judgment
concept: Three authored, illustrative document sources settle into a ruled alignment matrix. Each requirement occupies a horizontal lane crossing vendor reply and evidence columns, and a warm optical review band makes the act of comparison visible. The selected evidence condition changes the first lane and its next action: an empty reference produces a clarification request, while a linked reference permits a draft for human review. The last two phases preserve original material and leave human judgment visibly open. No diagram data represents performed engineering, an actual vendor assessment, or approval.
metaphor: A paper comparison table examined through an optical review band.
choreography: Context: three staggered document leaves arrive with a visible evidence gap.
Structure: the leaves become three horizontal requirement lanes and three source columns; the review band scans upward once.
Explore: the band isolates the first clause; the selected evidence state directly changes the evidence cell and next action.
Review: retained source text sits beside a separate annotated draft or clarification, connected by a traceable line.
Outcome: a source stack accompanies the resulting document, and an open endpoint preserves human judgment or unresolved evidence.
interaction: The host's missing/linked evidence choice changes the first evidence cell and the next action in phase 2, and carries the conditional clarification or draft into phases 3 and 4. Linked evidence never implies applicability or approval.
contributions: A reusable horizontal review-band animation that remains informative when paused or reduced motion is enabled.
A deterministic conditional evidence cell and output state without fabricated conclusions.
A bilingual SVG vocabulary and document geometry that separate original sources, changes, rationale and human judgment.
limitations: All diagram data is illustrative, not performed engineering; the Envelope, Interface and Scope lanes demonstrate structure only.
Document marks are visual abstractions, not actual source contents or provenance records.
The linked evidence illustration does not establish relevance, applicability, completeness or final approval.
Node checks establish rendering determinism and contract structure; actual browser rendering remains a separate host-level check.
